- 所以人们都知道，那红灵芝对身体好处：这样，有好处

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Temporality): 他把灵芝放在包里：他把灵芝放在包里了，use 了 for this completed action in the narrative sequence.

Run 3: Coherence (Temporality): 他把灵芝放在包里：他把灵芝放进了包里，Use “了” after the resultative complement “进” to show that this placement action was completed.
